Introducing Saved Views, available today for everyone on a paid plan. Saved Views lets you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on, so you never have to rebuild a custom setup from scratch. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, monitoring a specific sprint, or checking in on a teammate's workload, you can save that configuration once and return to it with a single click.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving individuals and teams plenty of room to organize dashboards for every project, client, or workflow they manage. Views can also be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating filters over and over. This makes onboarding new teammates faster and keeps reporting consistent across your organization.

Saved Views is rolling out now across every paid plan, with no extra setup required. Give it a try on your next project.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
